as_told.title: Alex Jones' CNN call warning Osama bin Laden about the Twin Towers

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Alex Jones, a radio host known for his unusual beliefs, made an on-air warning before the September 2001 attacks on the World Trade Center in New York, saying that if a terrorist group hit the towers, people would know who to blame. In another episode Michels tells it a little differently, placing the call on the news channel CNN and having Jones speak directly to Osama bin Laden. Michels brings it up in talks about seeing the future, as a possible case of someone sensing an event before it happened.
